title: Normalized ordinary supported source quotient
statement: For a prime $\ell$, an arbitrary scheme $Y$, and an ordinary reduction presentation $D$ of scalar extension from abelian sheaves to constant $\mathbf Z_\ell$-module sheaves on $W=\mathbf P^1_Y\times_Y\mathbf P^1_Y$ [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface], every level $n$ of $D(\Delta_*\mathbf Z)$ is isomorphic to the supported constant $\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1}$, restricted to $\mathbf Z_\ell$. The isomorphism $s$ satisfies $\mathrm{DiagonalSourceNormalization}$: its quotient map, preceded by the insertion-of-one scalar unit, is the specified supported integral generator. No invertibility hypothesis on $Y$ is imposed.

proof.text: Identify scalar extension of the supported integral constant with the supported p-adic constant, with its specified insertion-of-one integral generator. This is an ordinary scalar-unit comparison and uses no invertibility hypothesis.

For A=ULift(Z_l), the lifted coefficient projection to ULift(ZMod(l^(n+1))) is surjective. PadicInt.ker_toZModPow identifies its kernel with the image of multiplication by l^(n+1), so it is a cokernel in ModuleCat A. Constant sheafification and finite direct image preserve that cokernel. The diagonal is finitely presented because it is the diagonal of the smooth projective line. The sheafification/restriction comparison identifies the cokernel target with the supported residue constant restricted to p-adic scalars.

Transport the coefficient cokernel through the supported p-adic scalar-extension isomorphism. Compare it with D.quotient by CokernelCofork.mapIsoOfIsColimit. The comparison preserves the quotient maps. The sheafification naturality and constant restriction comparison show that the coefficient map sends each constant generator a to its residue. Apply pro_supported_generator_scalar and the scalar-extension unit equation to obtain DiagonalSourceNormalization.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonal_source_quotient_normalization (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (D : DiagonalReductionPresentation ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ s : (D.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)).obj (op n) ≅
      (diagonalFiniteToPadic ℓ n (diagonalSurface Y)).obj
        ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n)) (diagonalImmersion Y)).obj
          (geoCartierConstant (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n) (ProjectiveLine Y))),
      DiagonalSourceNormalization ℓ Y D n s
